'''Wenbas Court''' was a public place located near the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was not uncommon to see tourists having lunch at the court.<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
